_comment: REAL published Con Edison bill history — NYC Residential SC 1 — transcribed for the bill-reconstruction regression tests (test/test.js Tests 14–15). These are ConEd's own published average bills at 300 kWh/month, NOT individual customer bills: they are the ground truth the reconstruction engine must reproduce before any counterfactual can be trusted. Rates are cents per kWh; bill amounts are US$ for the 300 kWh sample month. Integrity checks in the test suite guard the transcription itself (components must sum to published totals; bill amounts must equal sampleKwh × rates; year columns must average to the published 36-month columns).
publication: Con Ed Electric Average Bill History — NYC Residential - SC 1 (Average Monthly Electric Bill at 300 kWh)
retrievedFrom: web.archive.org snapshot 2026-07-03T22:45:29Z of the URL above (coned.com blocks automated fetches)
publicationNotes: Bills do not include Customer Charge and BPP
Bills are grossed up for GRT and sales tax

Published column totals are computed from unrounded rates, so they differ from the sum of the rounded component rates by ~0.0001 cents/kWh (e.g. 2024 sums to 33.4534 vs the published 33.4533) — the integrity checks in test/test.js allow that tolerance rather than treating it as a transcription error
